flowchart TB
    subgraph BUILD["Learning: wires first, behaviour last"]
      direction LR
      b1["memorise:
many weak directions"] --> b2["wires attached one by one
(behaviour ~0)"] --> b3["last wire:
the circuit works"]
    end
    subgraph BREAK["Forgetting: fast, in two ways"]
      direction LR
      r1["small model, large moves — REWIRING:
joints weaken from step 2; behaviour gone by
step 160 with 79% of the circuit in place"]
      d1["large model, tiny moves — DRIFT:
wiring untouched; many small nudges in keys,
values and MLPs; copying gone in 10–50 steps"]
      r1 ~~~ d1
    end
    subgraph AFTER["Afterwards"]
      direction LR
      a1["toy: permanent only once the new task
is learned and generalises"]
      a2["at scale: only a conflicting task
forgets at all"]
      a1 ~~~ a2
    end
    BUILD --> BREAK --> AFTER
